blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Ride-hailing giant Grab is getting a new boss for its Philippine operations as its managing director exits after more than eight years. Grab Philippines on Thursday named CJ Lacsican as its new country managing director, effective Dec. 1. She replaces Ronald Roda, who is stepping down to pursue entrepreneurial opportunities. READ: Delivery app sustains business by empowering merchants At Grab, Lacsican has overseen central operations, cities, financial services and, most recently, mobility and operations businesses in the Philippines.
